Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User aims to increase monthly savings by $300; stated never owned individual stocks, only 401(k) index funds.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent reviewed Acme Bank checking, logged $45 gym membership, and ran avalanche debt payoff for $200 Visa payment.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent analyzed mortgage refinancing (Greenfield/BankPlus) to 3.1% (saving $85/mo) and delivered 2026 charitable donation tax summary ($150 City Food Bank, $200 Green Park Trust).

Date: May 25, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User allocated $1,200 freelance payment, set emergency fund target at $24,000, and set up automatic $250 high-yield savings transfer per payday.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent logged $60 pet subscription, reviewed Horizon Investments 401(k) match, and analyzed student loan refinance (LendCo/Apex Finance).
* ✅ (16:40) Agent provided medical expense deduction report (IRS Pub 502) and credit score impact summary.

Date: May 28, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User allocated $350 energy rebate, set up $180/mo automatic Roth IRA contribution, and requested short-term savings for a $3,200 vacation.
* 🟡 (09:30) Agent reviewed Bank of Riverside mortgage amortization, compared auto insurance (SafeDrive, ShieldGuard, ProtectAuto), and recommended CapitalOne 2.1% HYSA.
* ✅ (14:30) Agent updated investment spreadsheet and calculated $420 annual tax savings from Roth IRA contributions.

Date: May 31, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User allocated $150 utility credit to student loans, set up $250 automatic transfer to money market, and asked about tax-advantaged accounts for a $3,500 year-end bonus.
* 🟡 (07:50) Agent analyzed student loan interest savings ($1,200 over 2 yrs via debt snowball) and researched regional bank HSA options.
* ✅ (17:30) Agent updated cash-flow forecast incorporating money market transfer and bonus deposit.

Date: Jun 4, 2026
* 🔴 (12:00) User allocated $200 utility rebate to credit cards ($950 interest saved over 18 mos), scheduled $180 monthly Roth IRA transfer, and requested tax-efficient investment for a $4,200 quarterly bonus.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent researched Solo 401(k) options at two fintechs and updated the 12-month cash-flow model.
* ✅ (14:30) Agent completed Solo 401(k) guide and cash-flow model update.

Date: Jun 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User asked about $300 tax refund allocation to HSA ($3,850 2026 family cap), set aside $150/mo for a Costa Rica vacation next summer, and requested low-fee index fund diversification options.
* 🔴 (19:10) User stated tax filing extension ends June 18, 2026.
* 🟡 (07:50) Agent reviewed 2026 HSA limits, ran cash-flow sensitivity for July's $1,200 car insurance, and drafted credit card APR reduction email template.
* ✅ (15:20) Agent updated 12-month cash-flow model for vacation savings and HSA contributions.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Provide low-fee index fund recommendations for portfolio diversification beyond current 401(k) holdings.
- Secondary: Acknowledge the upcoming tax filing extension deadline on June 18, 2026.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>

</suggested-response>
